record.body:
## Evidence

Probe: app.focused was ContentTabs after load; down left cursor_row 0. Seven keys-only tests red before the fix, green after; full suite 262 passed.

## Consequence

Earlier tests hid this by clicking or by arranging the target task as the top row.

## Follow-up

status-tabs and phase-sections reuse focus_tasks().

payload.basis: Real-store probe and 7 red keys-only tests before 2d1a3be; all pass after
payload.claim: Nothing focused the task table; the effort tab strip kept focus, so arrows never moved the cursor and enter always opened row 0
payload.invalidated_when: A keys-only test fails to move or open a task after 2d1a3be
